item.name: AUTHZ-VOL-LIST-CROSS-DENY — [INV-10] alice List volumes projectId=projectB1 (нет viewer) → 403 PERMISSION_DENIED (scope {project,project_id})

exec: pm.test('harness config: jwtProjectAdminA1 is set (subject under test)', () => {

pm.expect.fail('jwtProjectAdminA1 is not set — the authz-fixture seed (tests/authz-fixtures/setup.sh) did not provide this subject. Running the step anonymously would test a DIFFERENT principal and pass for the wrong reason.');
